item.description: Is drinking coffee good for your health? The answer appears to be yes. item.title: In Rochester, pay phones are working again—and they’re free
item.description: Two years ago, the last pay phones were disconnected in Rochester, New York. But a group of volunteers has started bringing a handful of phones back—and making them free to use. Called the GoodPhone Project, the effort is aimed at people who still don’t have reliable access to a mobile phone, including those experiencing homelessness.
